decision_effects.epss: Actual L1 action versus the same full case with every observed EPSS probability set to zero; missing data and hard rules preserved.
decision_effects.reachability: Actual L1 action versus the same full case with measured reachability replaced by unknown; hard rules preserved.
decision_effects.aggregation: Whole case, maximum over all real findings; no target-CVE-only decision substituted for the whole image.
decision_effects.planned_positive_contrast: Fixed, CVSS 7.5, low EPSS, explicitly unreachable finding scores about 0.476 and can allow_with_findings, versus about 0.526 with unknown reachability. Other findings can mask this; report actual whole-case results.
decision_effects.high_epss_limitation: Existing podinfo HTTP/2 calls can make these high-EPSS cases request review even with EPSS zero. They measure high-risk cases but may not isolate an EPSS-only action change. Do not claim they do.

compatibility_note: grpc 1.83.2 calls HTTP/2 Framer APIs absent from old x/net. HTTP/2 cases also pin grpc 1.74.3; build failures are excluded, never counted as security blocks.
